## Learning objectives

By the end of this chapter, you should be able to:

1. Explain the time value of money and calculate present and future values
2. Define interest rates and describe how they are determined
3. Identify the main types of financial markets and what they do
4. Explain how financial markets channel savings into investment
5. Describe how interest rates connect the financial system to the real economy
